slides.voiceover_text: Here's a profit leak hiding in most service businesses. You're losing leads every single day after five pm, and you probably don't even know it.

slides.voiceover_text: Tip one. Voicemail won't save the lead. Most callers won't leave a message. They just ring the next name on the list.

slides.text: Speed wins. First to answer gets the job
slides.voiceover_text: Tip two. Speed wins. The business that answers first, sounds human, and takes the details usually gets the job.

slides.voiceover_text: Tip three. Put something in place that answers after hours, so the calls you can't take don't walk straight to a competitor.

slides.voiceover_text: So remember. The after-hours phone is where quiet money leaks out. Cover it, and you turn missed calls into booked work.
